title: Bike Outliner Extension Manifest
description: The extension's id and display name are derived from the .bkext folder name. The id is the folder name without the .bkext suffix. The display name is the folder name split on '-' with each word capitalized (e.g., 'heading-levels.bkext' becomes 'Heading Levels').

$schema.description: The schema to verify this document against.

description.description: A brief description of what the extension does.

version.description: The version of the extension, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.2.3).

api_version.description: The minimum Bike extension API version this extension requires (see bike.apiVersion; the extension kit's package version tracks it). Copied to the registry entry's min_api_version on submit.

permissions.description: List of permissions the extension requires. Available permissions: clipboardRead (read from system clipboard), clipboardWrite (write to system clipboard), openURL (open URLs in the default browser), keychain (store secrets in the macOS Keychain).

host_permissions.description: URL patterns the extension needs access to for fetch() requests (e.g., "https://api.example.com/*").

url.description: URL for the extension's homepage or source code.
